g.text: Saberu Onboard → Managed → Re-Audit — AS-BUILT (real VPS, 2026-07-12)
Proven on test-vps-u24 (Ubuntu 24.04) + test-vps-d13 (Debian 13.5). r9 first blocked at EPEL; later RHEL steps remain unverified.
root@22 · packages · UFW (Debian) · fail2ban(+EPEL on RHEL)
reuse the run's key (no mounted file)
Managed validation runs BEFORE port 22 is closed, so an onboard
failure leaves root@22 open and the host re-runnable (no auto-rollback).
make controller-vps-smoke re-asserts success + changed=0 on demand.
